changelog: Added Shizuku and root next to ADB: choose how agents reach your phone in Settings → ADB Connect. Agents use adb, Shizuku (rish) or root only when you ask
ADB Connect now reconnects a paired phone by itself when you open it or tap refresh
Fixed Antigravity sign-in: when your Google account isn't allowed, the app now shows why instead of waiting forever
Fixed OpenCode custom providers whose models didn't show up in the model list or in chat (newer OpenCode versions)
Redesigned OpenCode's custom provider editor: full screen, fast with hundreds of models, with search, filters and select all
Added Images, Reasoning and Tools switches for each model of an OpenCode custom provider; "Fetch from endpoint" fills them in from the endpoint, Ollama or models.dev
Added Effort and Thinking controls to OpenCode chats for models that support them, and a warning when you attach an image to a model that can't read images
Added a "Fold after" option for grouped agent steps: how many steps fold into one pill (2 by default)
Agent memory is now on by default; saving chats for agents to look up is now off by default
Added Settings → Updates: get beta updates, and choose how often AntiGem checks for updates in the background
Fixed the app not starting on Android 7 and 8
Back on the main chat screen now moves AntiGem to the background instead of closing it
Fixed a crash on the Claude Code and Codex Plugins pages when the same plugin was installed more than once
Added a Discord community link in Settings → About

Added Settings → Pets: Gemmy now has 7 friends: Kitsu the nine-tailed fox, Frost the polar bear cub, Beep the robot, Mochi the cat, Cinder the baby dragon, Mist the ghost and Lotl the axolotl. Each has its own reactions, a signature move and a favourite treat
Added on/off switches for each skill, MCP server and plugin of Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: turn one off without removing it
Web pages in chat can now be sites made of several files (HTML, CSS, JS) or a page saved on the phone, and the new /playground command makes live HTML/CSS/JS pages
The IDE can show Markdown files as a formatted preview, and switch back to editing the source

More security: plugins ask before every install and update, other apps can no longer make AntiGem open its private files, and home-screen shortcuts and widgets are signed (Settings → Home screen → Link key)
Plugins in /sdcard/antiGem/extensions no longer load, because any app could put code there: install them again in Settings → Plugins
Jarvis: approve a command by voice ("yes, run it"), see everything Jarvis approved for you, and it asks before switching Claude Code to a mode that asks you less
Backups without "include secrets" now leave out SSH keys, API keys, logins and shell histories, and crash reports hide paths, addresses and tokens before you see or send them
Added a Phone tools key in Settings → Where agents run: make a new key if you think yours leaked. On servers, the bridge token no longer shows in the process list
Wireless debugging that AntiGem turned on now turns itself off after 10 idle minutes, and a changed SSH host key now shows the new key's fingerprint
Fixed connection (SSL) errors and a crash on Android 7 and 7.1
Fixed a crash when changing the app's language while an agent was working
Fixed exporting and sharing OpenCode chats from the chat list ("conversation not found")
Fixed Claude Code sometimes losing the last reply or error line at the end of a turn
Saving a file in the IDE now keeps its permissions (scripts stay executable), and moving a folder into its parent folder no longer deletes it
Antigravity subagent chats now sit under the chat that started them, and opening a chat no longer unfolds its subagents
Fixed termux-tts-speak staying silent on its first text, and voice messages in chat sometimes playing the wrong recording
